scenarios.label: SSP2-4.5
scenarios.description: Intermediate greenhouse-gas emissions pathway (CMIP6 ScenarioMIP, SSP2 socioeconomics with ~4.5 W/m² forcing by 2100).

scenarios.label: SSP5-8.5
scenarios.description: Very high greenhouse-gas emissions pathway (CMIP6 ScenarioMIP, SSP5 socioeconomics with ~8.5 W/m² forcing by 2100).

disclaimer: Scenarios are conditional climate projections: they describe what models simulate IF a given emissions pathway is followed. They are not predictions or guaranteed outcomes.
